newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds end up on heavy demand.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds end up on heavy demand.

text.p: 1635 GMT - Dutch bonds end higher but off day's peaks on Tuesday after brisk trading session. Long end outperforms again as market players switch out of shorter maturities into both Dutch bonds and Bunds maturing after 2006, dealers say. Siemens issues exerts no noticeable pressure on ten-years. Mood good.
* Sept 2001 adds 0.23 to 117.80/90, yielding 4.37 pct at bid.
* 10-year yield spread versus Jan 2007 Bund widens to -11 basis
* Jan 2023s add 0.66 to close at 116.60/80, 6.19 pct bid yield.
